SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - SEPTEMBER 21, 2015 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
SEPTEMBER 21, 2015, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Dr. Bill Ebling, First Baptist Church of Fullerton.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by the City of Cerritos Recreation Services Division
  Campers in Leadership Training Program.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair George Ray
  Mayor/Chair Carol Chen

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  Proclamations were presented as follows:

  Microsoft Cerritos (Business Spotlight)

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  David Montgomery and Telma Woodley presented the City Council with a plaque
  commemorating the Special Olympics World Games from the Host Town
  Committee.

  Levy Sun, Public Information Officer, Greater Los Angeles County Vector Control
  District displayed a PowerPoint Presentation outlining his Agency’s various
  programs.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one
  motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency
  Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the
  Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated September 21,
  2015 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated September 21, 2015 in the total amount of
  $3,956,134.94 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:
 City of Cerritos  September 21, 2015

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7A.  (continued)

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency dated September 21,
  2015 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the Successor Agency dated September 21, 2015 in the total amount of
  $2,014,089.82 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  September 10, 2015 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of September 10, 2015
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING VARIOUS SECTIONS OF THE CERRITOS
  MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO THE CREATION OF AN EXPEDITED PERMITTING
  PROCESS FOR SMALL RESIDENTIAL ROOFTOP SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEMS, IN
  CONFORMANCE WITH CALIFORNIA STATE ASSEMBLY BILL 2188 (2014), HEREIN
  REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2015-2 (COUNCIL)*.

  *Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments. Noting there were no
  individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments and the public
  hearing.
 City of Cerritos  September 21, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 5

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8A.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Pulido, to:
  1. Approve Development Code Amendment 2015-2, making the findings set forth in
  Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. 2015-23, and
  2. Waive reading of and introduce Ordinance No. 997, AN ORDINANCE OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING VARIOUS SECTIONS OF THE CERRITOS
  MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO THE CREATION OF AN EXPEDITED
  PERMITTING PROCESS FOR SMALL RESIDENTIAL ROOFTOP SOLAR
  ENERGY SYSTEMS, IN CONFORMANCE WITH CALIFORNIA STATE
  ASSEMBLY BILL 2188 (2014), HEREIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT
  CODE AMENDMENT 2015-2 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of playground equipment at Bettencourt Park, Jacob
  Park and Liberty Park (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Sherre Titus, Recreation Services Superintendent. A
  PowerPoint Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Anthony Morrow and Adrienne Morrow thanked the Council for approving the playground
  equipment at Bettencourt Park.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to:
  1. Select “Starburst” as the the color palette for the new playground equipment at
  Bettencourt Park, and
  2. Select “Ocean” as the the color palette for the new playground equipment at Jacob
  Park, and
  3. Select “Liberty” as the the color palette for the new playground equipment at Liberty
  Park (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  September 21, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 5

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  Review and consideration of award of Bid No. 1218-16 printing of the 2016 Cerritos
  Community Calendar (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Laurie Kajiwara, Public Information Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to award Bid No. 1218-16
  for the printing of the 2016 Cerritos Community Calendar to Advantage Mailing, Inc. in
  the amount of $20,951.85 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  Chen
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for Citywide Water Feature
  Maintenance and Repair, Bid No. 1212-16 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Hal Arbogast, Director of Public Works.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to award a twelve month
  contract for Citywide Water Feature Maintenance and Repair, Bid 1212-16 to Service First
  of Santa Ana, California (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for Cerritos Park East rubberized
  track resurfacing, Project No. 12797, Bid No. 1219-16 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Hal Arbogast, Director of Public Works.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Edwards, to reject the sole bid
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  September 21, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 5

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal Legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Pulido and Edwards, Mayor Pro Tem
  Ray and Mayor Chen.

12.  Closed Session

  The City Attorney noted that the City Council would recess to Closed Session to
  discuss item 12A on the Closed Session agenda.

12A.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION

  Pursuant to Paragraph (1) of subdivision (d) of Government Code Section
  54956.9
  Name of Case: Cerritos v. State of California

  REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION:

  The City Council reconvened into Open Session. The City Attorney announced that
  the City Council recessed to Closed Session to discuss item 12A on the Closed Session
  agenda.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Edwards, to authorize the filing of
  a Petition for Review of Cerritos v. State of California, Third District California
  Court of Appeal, Case No. C070484 with the California Supreme Court.

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 8:43 p.m.
